plugins.name: bend-spec
plugins.description: Spec-first work for Bend projects that keep their guarantees as law files: audit a project and roll out proofs until every guarantee is a proved law file, then add features as law file, quantified laws, proof, gate; speed one up without weakening a law.

plugins.name: bend-ecosystem
plugins.description: Find who on GitHub depends on the Emerging-Patterns Bend packages (bolt, ez, the ez libraries), and tell real dependents from mentions and listings.

plugins.name: bend-fleet
plugins.description: Upgrade ez-managed Bend packages to each other's latest releases, one package or the whole fleet: bump deps leaves first, release, publish to the hub by hash, update flake ez and [tools.bolt] pins, and verify READMEs as a plain Bend user.
